representativeness.statement: 15 synthetic papers (12 Markdown, 3 generated PDFs) uploaded as 16 private items plus 2 metadata-only common items, 87 indexed body/abstract chunks, versus the proposed 1,000-paper x 20-page workload. Results only exercise the pipeline, ACL gates and locator matching on short, cleanly written English text; they do not represent real extraction quality, real-paper vocabulary, scale effects on ranking, or other languages and domains.

providers.generation: local capture called for eligible packs; no external generation; returns no claims
providers.note: The run overrides pricing_verified only on an in-process Settings copy bound to local fakes; the default and .env values above are unchanged.

retrieval.coverage_rule: chunk contains 100% of a gold span (same item, kind, page; valid half-open offsets)

diagnostic_overlap_50.rule: chunk holds >= 50% of a gold span's characters; diagnostic only, not a headline result

not_measured.rerank: Rerank needs an OpenRouter call; pricing_verified=false and outbound HTTP is blocked.
not_measured.semantic_vector_quality: Vectors come from a local hashed bag of words, not openai/text-embedding-3-small.
not_measured.grounded_answer_rate: No answer was generated; the capture returns no claims. Needs generation plus human review.
not_measured.citation_accuracy: No generated citations exist. Needs generation plus human review.
not_measured.abstention_appropriateness: Final abstention depends on generation for every question whose evidence reached the pack.
not_measured.latency_p95: Single in-process run on a dev machine with fakes; not the proposed 5-user workload.
not_measured.cost_and_charge: No provider call was made; ledger rows hold 0-token local estimates only.

measurement.note: Git state captured before seeding and before report files were written.

m4d3_same_seed_dev.note: M4d-2 baseline and final dev evaluated on the same seeded DB; holdout evaluated once after final rule.

review_pair_reference_dev.note: Previous PR #14 resolver and final resolver ran on the same dev seed; only final policy evaluated on holdout.
